Efficient-influence-function estimator of the scale-indexed proportion mediated

Source: R/rg-flow.R
g_hat_eif.Rd

Estimates g_l = NIE_l / TE_l on coarse-grained data by plug-in, with a cluster-robust standard error from the efficient influence function. The plug-in is already efficient in the linear-Gaussian case, so no cross-fitting is performed.

Usage

g_hat_eif(Z, cluster, m = 1, ci_level = 0.95)

Arguments

Z

Numeric matrix with columns A, M, Y (coarse-grained units, as returned by rg_coarse_grain()).

cluster

Cluster labels for the rows of Z. The i.i.d. sampling unit is the cluster, not the row; passing unit-level labels would understate every standard error.

m

Numeric: the aggregation scale Z was produced at (recorded, not recomputed).

ci_level

Numeric: confidence level for the Wald interval.

Value

An RgFlowResult.

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(
  A = rnorm(400), M = rnorm(400), Y = rnorm(400),
  sch = rep(1:40, each = 10)
)
cg <- rg_coarse_grain(d, m = 2, cluster = "sch")
fit <- g_hat_eif(cg$Z, cg$cluster, m = 2)
fit@g
#> [1] 0.03047159
